description: This source file defines a helper class `ApiTokenHelper` for generating JWT tokens for testing purposes, specifically for admin and normal user roles in integration tests.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token representing an admin user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token representing a normal user.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified username and roles, used internally by the other methods.
